remarks: Bright and spacious very attractive two bedroom unit, featuring vaulted wood-beam ceilings, large living room/dining room with floor to ceiling brick fireplace and peaceful view of the woods from the deck. The remodeled kitchen includes brand-new stainless steel appliances, custom cabinetry, granite countertops and generous counter space-ideal for any home chef. The primary bedroom offers ample closet space. This is a must see!       Located just 5 miles from Metro North and minutes from Post Road, I-95, and vibrant SoNo. This move-in-ready home offers comfort, convenience, and style in one of the area's most sought-after communities.  Don't miss this opportunity-schedule a showing today!
